about: Plain labels, in our own words, for the toggles of weapons and sets that have no decision file (they stay off). The planner shows each as '<item>: <label>' for every character alike, so a label says what the bonus is and when it holds, never repeats the item and names no one ('the Skill', not 'her Skill'). kitgen reads this file for every gear toggle without a decision file and stops if one is missing or unused; `run.py kits` is still the only writer of kits.json.
